summary: Iter15 — Re-verified Vivo Training analytics feature (backend proxy + frontend page). 23/23 backend pytest tests pass against live external Vivo Training API. Frontend renders correctly with all KPIs, filters, tables, and charts populated. Lateness -3h adjustment confirmed end-to-end (Odoo upstream 10.54h → KPI 7.48h ✓). All 12 /api/training/* endpoints return 200 with manager auth, 401 without. Filter changes correctly retrigger 10 API calls each. Existing iteration_14.json content preserved.

minor.issue: Associate session test_session_vivo_assoc_1778250692444 returns role='manager' from /api/auth/me, so associate access tests cannot distinguish 403 vs 200. Pre-existing seed bug carried from iter12/iter13 — code path uses Depends(require_manager) correctly, but the seed itself is wrong. Not a Training-feature regression.

integration_issues.issue: Expected: associate is redirected to /dashboard and sidebar hides nav-training. Actual: associate sees /training page with full data, nav-training is visible. Root cause: /api/auth/me returns role='manager' for the seeded associate session (pre-existing iter12 seed bug). Frontend role-gating logic in App.js/AppShell.jsx is implemented correctly — it just receives wrong role.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount (pre-existing cosmetic, also flagged in iter14). Charts render correctly once container measures.

Lateness -3h shift verified: Odoo upstream avg=10.54h, max=11.70h → proxied avg=7.54h, max=8.70h (verified via direct upstream vs proxy diff + parameterised pytest).
Lateness clamping at 0 verified (detail rows compared upstream vs proxied, no negative values).

Frontend /training renders for manager with data-testid='training-page'.
All 6 KPI tiles populate: Employees=80, Sessions=1,936, Departments=3, Avg hrs=13.51h, Budget=Ksh 360,800, Lateness=7.48h (Africa/Nairobi UTC+3).
Avg lateness KPI shows 7.48h (matches expected ~7.48h = 10.48h upstream avg − 3h). PASS.
All 7 filter controls present (filter-date-from, filter-date-to, filter-category, filter-training, filter-department, filter-delivery, filter-reset).
Changing filter-date-from triggers 10 downstream /api/training/* refetches with date_from query forwarded.
filter-reset triggers refetch and restores 7.48h lateness.
Tables populated: status-row=3, lateness-row=25, top-emp=10, facilitators panel shows 1 facilitator.
Sidebar has nav-training for manager session.

rca_of_the_issue: The lateness 3h overshoot bug (raw upstream times in UTC while training start was already in Africa/Nairobi local) is fixed in proxy via _adjust_lateness_payload: walks by_training[] and detail[], applies max(0, value - 3) and rounds to 2 dp. Sets timezone_adjusted=true and timezone_offset_hours=3 in response. End-to-end verified: upstream Odoo avg 10.54h → proxy 7.54h; upstream Quality Standards avg 10.45h → proxy 7.45h; frontend KPI displays 7.48h (overall avg across trainings). No clamping violations observed in detail rows.
